# Browser dependencies

Locally served; no CDN or build step at runtime.

- Marked 18.0.12: `marked/lib/marked.umd.js` (MIT)
- DOMPurify 3.4.15: `dompurify/dist/purify.min.js` (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0)

Sources: https://github.com/markedjs/marked and https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify.
Keep licenses alongside distributions. Pin exact npm versions when updating,
and run Markdown injection browser checks.
